title: CoinGecko Top Coins Pro
description: Pro-tier variant of coingecko_top_coins. Preserves all base columns and adds volatility_score (RMS of the 1h/24h/7d/30d % changes - a quick proxy for recent realised vol), momentum_score (weighted blend of the same four deltas with longer windows down-weighted), and sharpe_proxy (momentum_score divided by volatility_score when positive). Lets Claude identify coins that have moved strongly AND consistently rather than just spikily. trust_level: unrestricted - requires numpy for the vector ops (importable in the sandbox but cleaner here; this variant also demonstrates the pattern for non-allowlisted future extensions).
code:
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import requests
import time
from datetime import datetime, timezone

BASE = 'https://api.coingecko.com/api/v3'
now_epoch = int(datetime.now(timezone.utc).timestamp())
rows = []

for page in range(1, 3):
    resp = requests.get(
        f'{BASE}/coins/markets',
        params={
            'vs_currency': 'usd',
            'order': 'market_cap_desc',
            'per_page': 250,
            'page': page,
            'sparkline': 'false',
            'price_change_percentage': '1h,24h,7d,30d',
        },
        timeout=30,
    )
    resp.raise_for_status()
    coins = resp.json()
    if not coins:
        break
    for c in coins:
        mcap = float(c.get('market_cap', 0) or 0)
        vol = float(c.get('total_volume', 0) or 0)
        ath = float(c.get('ath', 0) or 0)
        price = float(c.get('current_price', 0) or 0)
        ath_pct = round(((price - ath) / ath) * 100, 2) if ath > 0 else 0.0
        vol_mcap = round(vol / mcap, 4) if mcap > 0 else 0.0

        c1 = float(c.get('price_change_percentage_1h_in_currency', 0) or 0)
        c24 = float(c.get('price_change_percentage_24h', 0) or 0)
        c7 = float(c.get('price_change_percentage_7d_in_currency', 0) or 0)
        c30 = float(c.get('price_change_percentage_30d_in_currency', 0) or 0)

        changes = np.array([c1, c24, c7, c30], dtype=float)
        volatility_score = float(np.sqrt(np.mean(changes ** 2)))
        # Weighted momentum: longer windows contribute more stably
        weights = np.array([0.1, 0.3, 0.35, 0.25], dtype=float)
        momentum_score = float(np.dot(changes, weights))
        sharpe_proxy = round(float(momentum_score / volatility_score), 4) if volatility_score > 0 else 0.0

        rows.append({
            'rank': c.get('market_cap_rank', 0),
            'coin_id': c.get('id', ''),
            'symbol': str(c.get('symbol', '')).upper(),
            'name': c.get('name', ''),
            'price_usd': price,
            'change_1h_pct': round(c1, 2),
            'change_24h_pct': round(c24, 2),
            'change_7d_pct': round(c7, 2),
            'change_30d_pct': round(c30, 2),
            'volume_24h': vol,
            'market_cap': mcap,
            'vol_mcap_ratio': vol_mcap,
            'circulating_supply': float(c.get('circulating_supply', 0) or 0),
            'total_supply': float(c.get('total_supply', 0) or 0),
            'ath_usd': ath,
            'ath_distance_pct': ath_pct,
            'fully_diluted_valuation': float(c.get('fully_diluted_valuation', 0) or 0),
            # Pro additions:
            'volatility_score': round(volatility_score, 2),
            'momentum_score': round(momentum_score, 2),
            'sharpe_proxy': sharpe_proxy,
            '_epoch': now_epoch,
        })
    if page < 2:
        time.sleep(1.5)

df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
if not df.empty:
    df = df.sort_values(['sharpe_proxy', 'momentum_score'], ascending=[False, False]).reset_index(drop=True)
GENERATE_RESULTS(df)
